projects.title: Box Office Success Prediction
projects.description: • Predicting Box Office Success in terms of Surpassing the Break Even Point of a Movie using Machine Learning Algorithms including Linear/Logistic Regression and SVMs

projects.title: MoodMusic
projects.description:
• Coded in Python to configure various sensors to read in data of biometrics and surroundings of the user (heart rate, body temp., posture)
• Came up with the algorithm to categorize the input sensor data into different moods (happy, melancholy etc.) then make the pi to automatically choose a song of that mood for the user.
• Used Raspberry Pi Zero W to work as a music player in which 4 different sensors were soldered to it and run concurrently with python scripts.
